mainEntity.name: How long does quartz countertop installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The actual installation duration for quartz countertops typically takes one to two days, depending on the project's complexity, the size of the kitchen or bathroom, and the number of slabs required. However, the overall project timeline, from initial consultation and templating to final installation, can range from two to four weeks. This timeframe accounts for material selection, custom fabrication, and scheduling. It's crucial for us to confirm your cabinet readiness during the initial measurement phase, as any delays here can extend the project timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Actual installation generally takes 1-2 days, but the full project, including templating and fabrication, can range from two to four weeks. Cabinet readiness significantly impacts the overall timeline.
